continuation_reasoning:
IF IT TAKES 5 MACHINES 5 MINUTES TO MAKE 5 WIDGETS, THEN EACH MACHINE TAKES 5 MINUTES TO MAKE 1 WIDGET. THIS IS BECAUSE THE PRODUCTION RATE IS 1 WIDGET PER MACHINE PER 5 MINUTES. 

NOW, IF YOU HAVE 100 MACHINES, EACH MACHINE CAN STILL MAKE 1 WIDGET IN 5 MINUTES. THEREFORE, 100 MACHINES CAN MAKE 100 WIDGETS IN THE SAME TIME IT TAKES ONE MACHINE TO MAKE ONE WIDGET, WHICH IS 5 MINUTES. 

SO, IT WOULD TAKE 100 MACHINES 5 MINUTES TO MAKE 100 WIDGETS.
